# Keywords and positioning: a local plumber

A worked example of a keyword-research run, on a placeholder business (a
one-van plumber in a mid-sized town) and placeholder sources. It is the
fixture TestKeywordResearchWorkedExample walks; docs/departments.md quotes it.

## Research

- https://search-console.example/queries: our site's top queries, 90 days: "boiler repair near me", "blocked drain", "emergency plumber" (free, through the openseo connector)
- https://autocomplete.example/q=boiler+repair: completions: "boiler repair cost", "boiler repair same day", "boiler repair or replace"
- https://competitor-a.example/: a national chain; titles say "emergency plumber 24/7", "boiler installation"
- https://competitor-b.example/services: a local rival; headings "drain unblocking", "bathroom fitting"
- https://forum.example/t/landlord-boiler: landlords ask "who services boilers for rentals" and "gas safety certificate"
- https://reviews.example/plumbers-in-town: reviews praise "turned up when they said", "fixed price"

## Keywords

| Cluster | The ICP's words (source) | Intent | Difficulty | Our fit |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Boiler repair | "boiler repair near me", "boiler repair same day" (Search Console, autocomplete) | transactional | medium: the chain ranks nationally, no local page beats ours | own |
| Landlord boiler service | "boiler service for rentals", "gas safety certificate" (forum) | commercial | low: nobody local targets landlords | own |
| Emergency plumber | "emergency plumber 24/7" (competitor A) | transactional | high: the chain and directories hold the top results | leave: we don't cover nights |
| Drain unblocking | "blocked drain" (Search Console, competitor B) | transactional | medium: competitor B has a page | contest |
| Bathroom fitting | "bathroom fitting" (competitor B) | commercial | medium | leave: not our work |

## Positioning

**The same-day boiler plumber landlords can book at a fixed price.**

Rests on: Boiler repair (same day), Landlord boiler service (fixed price,
from the reviews' "fixed price" and "turned up when they said"). Leaves
emergency night calls and bathroom fitting to others.

For the owner to settle: is "fixed price" a promise we keep on every job?
